comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a robot-gripper opening stop; PR-2208 turns over an upright taped carton, cuts three bottom-tape paths, opens four bottom flaps, and collapses the intact carton flat.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests coaxial tool seating and coupled screw/nut countertorque; PR-2208 tests whole-carton turnover, guarded-blade path tracking, outward flap articulation, and intact wall-tube collapse.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a retained 90° opening through three cycles with nuts retained and tools clear; PR-2208 requires measured turnover, all 158 cut cells, four flaps opened at least 150°, then all board vertices within a 24 mm slab for a one-second released hold.
comparison.reason: Carton turnover, cutting, flap opening, and flattening do not exercise the candidate's coupled adjustment-preservation mechanism; PR-2208 lacks a formal task.json, complete-task run limit, full demo, model run, and media, but its tested outcome is still clearly unrelated.
